verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents its own grouping controls: you can change the error class, component, or stack trace, or send a custom fingerprint. That lets a developer steer which errors collapse together or stay apart going forward. There is no evidence of a merge or split action on issues that already exist, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: UI/API merge of existing duplicate issues, splitting an already-collapsed issue, retroactive regrouping of past notices, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can merge issues that are really the same bug and split ones the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed
